content.text: Senior data scientist with 7 years applying machine learning to quantitative trading strategies in finance.

content.title: Senior Data Scientist
bullets: Built and deployed gradient-boosted and deep learning models predicting short-term price movements for a systematic trading desk.
Designed statistical backtesting frameworks used to validate every strategy before live capital allocation.
Mentored 2 junior data scientists on experiment design and model evaluation.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Genomics
job.descriptionMd: We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to build machine learning models on genomic sequencing data for early cancer detection. Required: 5+ years applying ML/statistics in Python, strong experimental design and model evaluation skills. Prior genomics or healthcare domain experience is preferred but not required — we will train the right technical hire on the biology.
